locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: The inventory applies for Swiss agricultural buildings only, because of the solid method of construction.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
The data of the inventory are based on one example of a typical agricultural building.

# Included processes
The inventory takes into account the use of construction materials and building machines for construction, repair and replacement including waste disposal and the transportation of the materials to the building site. Not taken into account were direct emission of the construction, disposal of production waste and the use of resources during utilization phase.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: The inventory is calculated based on a solid database of agricultural buildings.
